_comment: Copy this file to %USERPROFILE%\.zamolxis\rvsq-config.json and fill in YOUR RAMQ details. This file stays on your machine only — it is never committed, logged, or sent anywhere except the official RVSQ site. NAM = the health-insurance number on your RAMQ card; card_seq_number = the small sequential number after your name on the card. birth_month is the value the RVSQ month dropdown expects (try the two-digit month, e.g. 03).
